page.overview:
Who is Dancing girl?

The dancing girl is a recurring non-player character in the Final Fantasy series. The dancing girls are, except for rare instances, nameless, and serve purely as entertainment.

Several dancing girls can be found in certain towns, with one girl acting as the receptionist in Pravoka's inn in later releases. Arylon is one of the few dancing girls to have been named, though her name appears only in the North American release on the NES. Unlike dancing girls in subsequent games, she does not dance for the party, but instead provides useful information to the Warriors of Light to aid them in their quest to restore the crystals. If she is talked to before entering the town of Pravoka, and when the party has accomplished all of the tasks she can talk about to them, she will have nothing to say and asks if the party wants to dance with her.

Another named dancing girl in the NES version is Darryl. Found in Onrac, she "loves having legs" and thus may be related to the mermaids; the hair design and color for the dancing girl and for the mermaid in that version are the same. However, the hair color of dancing girl in Onrac is red instead of blonde.

Three dancing girls are found across the Floating Continent. This is the first game in the series where the dancing girl will dance for the player's entertainment, which bears no impact on the story. The dancing girl in Ur makes an appearance during the ending sequence where she tries to kiss Ingus for saving the world, but is stopped by Princess Sara Altney.
